Rules (r17): depth 5; name = raw file name[folder](type) — [tags] inside the file name are dropped; a category is only accepted when it is a real folder name (anything else is removed, bundled add-ons included); type = the last suffix of the file name (xxx.hh.py → py); 直播文件 → live channels, PQ类 → XBPQ, YQ类 → XYQ, JS[Drpy] → drpy; extra config (spider jar / live URL) is left out when empty.

"Scan mode: · Source mode (recommended): treats .py/.js/.wv.js/.php/.html scripts, xbpq json under a PQ类 folder and xyq json under a YQ类 folder as playable sources; txt/m3u/db/zip/pkg are not scanned. · File mode: treats .txt/.m3u/.db/.zip/.pkg/.json as local media files (read by csp_FileSpider from local playlists / databases / archives); script files are not scanned. In short: a folder full of crawler scripts / rules → source mode; a folder of local playlists → file mode."
